items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: so me, like a fool, give it to him and within six weeks he had had it published.

ctx.x: See, so Claude came by the theatre and say hey Tom, give me that orchestration and I'll play it down at Roseland and I said oh, we played it enough and put it on a chair and Carey said, yeah, give it to him and let him play it down there, so me, like a fool, give it to him and within six weeks he had had it published. Joe Williams wrote the words.
